rationale: Original42 unmatched opportunities:22 had no feature-eligible nonburst mint,20 only other liquidity buckets. Requiring a trade in the preceding250ms selects active controls. Test a state-certified risk set separately, without relaxing liquidity matching to obtain better results.
population: New fixed-duration Pump-only native capture after context adapter verification. No reassignment of controls for original78 seeds, original canary, or new context engineering canary.
signal_rules: Original burst/persistence contract unchanged, including first-mint seeds and full one-second entry delay
control_risk_set_at_signal: Mint and SOL route known at least1s before the signal; no teacher matching
Exclude signal mint; verified non-Mayhem and supported mint/fee/state context
Same floor(log2(virtual SOL reserve lamports)) bucket as the signal at signal time
Original burst predicate definitively false. Missing/ambiguous data is not false
A quiet interval can establish false burst only if canonical transition and successful-event coverage is independently certified for the required lookback. No unobserved trade assumption
State observed by signal time and either <=1s old or independently certified unchanged through signal time using only then-available coverage evidence; no future endpoint checks
selection: One candidate by minimum SHA256 of canonical JSON [seed_id,mint], as in original selector. Reuse allowed and reported. Future signal status must not exclude a control. No candidate means unmatched, retained in denominator.
state_rule: New separately named continuity-certified mark specification; retain original strict-age comparator separately. Gap, startup, unknown fork/order, subscription activation uncertainty, or unverified update completeness means unresolved, not unchanged.
outcomes: Identical arm clocks and 0.1/0.5/1 SOL scenarios; report missingness and unique/reused controls plus conditional quote/net outcomes only where certified. Price/flow diagnostics and net economics remain separate.
registration_gate: Before collecting the separate experimental cohort, record fixed capture duration, supported context scope, coverage certification algorithm/version and evaluator hash. This proposal alone does not start validation or certify coverage.
